title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — Zanchius denies actu-sin in Adam: we were not yet actu
pass_a_gloss: Zanchius—whom Garrigues himself cites favorably in ch. 7—denies that: we were not yet actu, so we could not then sin actu. Placeus makes the question sharp against Garrigues's wording.
pass_b_english: That Zanchius—whom you praise for your view in chapter 7 of your treatise—denies, adding this reason: because we were not yet in act. For how could it be that, when we were not yet in act, we should sin by act?
source_text: Id Zanchius, quem tu pro tua sententia laudas Cap. tui tractatus vii. negat, addita hac ratione, quia nondum eramus actu. Nam qui fieri potuit, ut, quum nondum essemus actu, peccaremus actu?

lemmas.gloss: we were not yet in act
